dedupe_keys.name: env15 water abstraction tables for england

description: Defra produced the ENV15 water abstraction tables, which give the number of abstraction licences held and estimates of average abstraction in millions of cubic metres from non-tidal waters (groundwater and surface water) and tidal waters, by purpose including public water supply and agricultural and non-agricultural spray irrigation, for 2000 to 2018. Coverage is England. The tables are a free download as an ODS file under the Open Government Licence v3.0, with Excel available on request. Caveats: the series ends in 2018, and the values are estimates by purpose, not by site. Simulation uses: abstraction totals for water resource and drought planning of public supply and irrigation. Related records: England's Catchment Data Explorer (data-england-catchment-data-explorer-river-basin-management).
